given: Provider IDs are antigravity, claude and codex
expected: Jake represents Antigravity; Finn represents Claude; BMO represents Codex

given: All three connections healthy, no remaining work
expected: One group huddle; no duplicated solo sprites

given: Only Claude starts a routine task
expected: Finn reads map; Jake and BMO continue resting

given: All three work in different phases
expected: Each displays its own phase and stable provider label

given: Codex reports high thinking with zero errors
expected: BMO concentrates, without wounds or Ice King

given: One distinct Antigravity attempt fails and is retried
expected: Jake retry pose; error streak is one

given: Repeat the identical eventId/attemptId
expected: No added failure and no animation restart

given: Three distinct consecutive attempts fail
expected: Jake strained; other tools unaffected

given: A new successful attempt follows failures
expected: Streak resets; recover once; resume current work

given: Host marks a negative test as expected
expected: Do not count it as an agent retry/error

given: Codex is waiting for explicit user approval
expected: BMO awake idle; Needs approval label; no wounds

given: A healthy task takes a long time
expected: No invented error, injury or completion

given: One task-completed event then repeated snapshots
expected: Celebrate once for that task/run

given: A lower-revision progress event arrives after completion
expected: Task stays completed; no reopening

given: Same task explicitly restarts with a new runId
expected: New lifecycle; eligible for a new completion later

given: One Claude task completes while another runs
expected: Finn celebrates briefly then continues work; no false sleep

given: One task fails while another completes
expected: Failure stays visible; completion may use a badge

given: Host cancels a task with no other work
expected: Return to rest without success or injury celebration

given: Provider connection becomes unavailable
expected: Neutral unavailable state; preserve last truth; no fake sleep

given: Reconnect snapshot includes previously completed tasks
expected: Reconcile without replaying old celebrations

given: Two tasks request encounter mode
expected: One Ice King, one stable target, no effects aimed at sleepers

given: Encounter task waits for user input
expected: Suspend combat; show waiting; task remains unresolved

given: Final active task finishes and celebration ends
expected: Return solo characters then show one group huddle

given: Reduced motion enabled
expected: Static representative poses and truthful labels; no travel/combat loops

given: Inspect all state frames on light and dark backgrounds
expected: Transparent backgrounds and intact hats, feet, weapons; no grid clipping

given: Many events arrive while view is hidden
expected: Truth updates; resume latest state without a stale celebration burst

given: One PNG fails to load
expected: Provider name and textual status stay visible

given: No supported hook is available for a provider
expected: Mark that provider unavailable/demo-only; never claim it is live
